meta.schema_notes: cpi_index is an INDEX value (e.g. 100, 250.3), NOT an annual inflation percentage. Do not enter 0.18 or 18 here. certificate_rate and cbe_rate_sanity_check are DECIMAL fractions: 0.18 = 18%. Do not enter 18. gold_source_type / silver_source_type must be exactly 'external_reconstructed' or 'sabika_reference'. For external_reconstructed years: gold_gram_egp = gold_oz_usd × usd_egp / 31.1035 (World Gold Council + CBE historical USD/EGP); silver_price_egp = silver_oz_usd × usd_egp / 31.1035 (World Bank Pink Sheet + CBE historical USD/EGP). Current prices are always sabika_reference. Silver is future-ready in the schema and is NOT a UI path in v1.

methodology.inflation: Annual average CPI index from official CPI data. Current CPI = latest published monthly CPI.
methodology.gold_price: For years before Sabika historical/internal pricing is available (gold_source_type = 'external_reconstructed'): gold is calculated as an external reconstructed reference price using World Gold Council global gold price converted to EGP using CBE historical USD/EGP exchange rates (gold_gram_egp = gold_oz_usd × usd_egp / 31.1035). From the date Sabika historical data is available onward (gold_source_type = 'sabika_reference'): Sabika.app / internal Sabika reference 24k gram prices are used. Current gold = current Sabika reference price. All prices are reference prices only — not execution prices.
methodology.silver_price: For years before Sabika historical/internal pricing is available (silver_source_type = 'external_reconstructed'): silver is calculated as an external reconstructed reference price using World Bank Pink Sheet / global silver commodity price converted to EGP using CBE historical USD/EGP exchange rates (silver_gram_egp = silver_oz_usd × usd_egp / 31.1035). From the date Sabika historical data is available onward (silver_source_type = 'sabika_reference'): Sabika.app / internal Sabika reference prices are used. All prices are reference prices only.
methodology.bank_certificate: Representative EGP certificate path based on the most relevant/flagship NBE and Banque Misr public certificates available during each year, annualized, assuming yearly reinvestment.
methodology.cbe_rate_sanity_check: CBE interest-rate data used internally as a sanity check only, not as the customer-facing certificate path.
